lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Kiko, you’re the acting editor-in-chief now.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Did Enzo send you Paragon’s drive?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I... I don't have access to the account, Ma'am.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I work offline.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: But he gave me a flash drive.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Check it using the Office Computer.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: The whistleblower file should be there.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Right now, that interview transcript is raw and messy.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Center and bold the title at the top so it looks like an official record, not random class notes.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Keep the text left-aligned, but bold every interviewer question.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: If questions and answers look the same, readers get confused. Bold makes the questions pop so anyone can tell who's talking at a glance.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Check that flash drive on the computer. Center the title, and bold the questions so the interview is easy to read.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: We need this evidence crystal clear before Mr. Reyes comes back.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Good work getting that transcript cleaned up.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Let's see how you did.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: [FEEDBACK]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: We still have a long way to go before NSPC, but this buys us time.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Keep working on the publication issue.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Don't let Mr. Reyes catch us unprepared.
